topics.topic: Les Salutations: Bonjour, Bonsoir, Comment ça va ? and courteous replies
learningObjectives: Pronounce standard French greetings for morning, afternoon, and evening
Respond courteously to formal and informal inquiries of well-being
Distinguish between formal address (vous) and familiar address (tu)

topics.topic: L'Alphabet Français et les Accents (aigu, grave, circonflexe, cédille)
learningObjectives: Recite the 26 letters of the French alphabet with correct phonetics
Identify and write diacritical marks (é, è, ê, ç, à, ù, î, ô)
Spell names and common words using oral French alphabetical sounds

topics.topic: Se Présenter: Je m'appelle, J'ai ... ans, Je suis Nigérian(e)
learningObjectives: State personal identity, age, nationality, and place of residence in French
Conjugate the reflexive verb s'appeler in present singular forms
Differentiate masculine and feminine forms of nationalities

topics.topic: Les Nombres (1 à 50): Counting, age, and telephone numbers
learningObjectives: Count fluently in French from 1 to 50 with accurate pronunciation
Ask for and recite phone numbers and ages in dialogues
Perform simple addition and subtraction sums in spoken French

topics.topic: Les Objets de la Classe: Un livre, un stylo, une table, le tableau
learningObjectives: Identify and name everyday classroom stationery and furniture
Use definite (le, la, l', les) and indefinite articles (un, une, des) accurately
Formulate short sentences identifying objects using C'est and Ce sont

topics.topic: Le Verbe "Être" (To Be): Present tense conjugation and identity
learningObjectives: Conjugate the irregular auxiliary verb être across all personal pronouns
Construct affirmative and negative sentences using ne ... pas
Describe physical attributes and professions using appropriate adjective agreements

topics.topic: Contrôle Continu et Évaluation Orale de Mi-Semestre
learningObjectives: Assess pupil mastery of basic greetings, numbers, and conjugation of être
Evaluate individual spoken pronunciation in brief role-play dialogues
Provide remedial phonetics drills on difficult nasal vowel sounds

topics.topic: Le Verbe "Avoir" (To Have): Present tense conjugation and possession
learningObjectives: Conjugate avoir across singular and plural subject pronouns
Express possession of classroom objects and personal belongings
Express age correctly using J'ai ... ans rather than the English verb to be

topics.topic: Les Jours de la Semaine et les Mois de l'Année: Calendar and dates
learningObjectives: Recite days of the week from lundi to dimanche in chronological order
Name the twelve months of the year with correct oral intonation
State today's date and birthday dates using the structure C'est le...

topics.topic: La Famille: Le père, la mère, le frère, la sœur, and possessives
learningObjectives: Identify members of the nuclear family in French
Apply possessive adjectives (mon, ma, mes; ton, ta, tes) accurately
Present a brief oral sketch describing family relatives and occupations

topics.topic: Les Couleurs et la Description Physique Simple
learningObjectives: Name primary and secondary colors in French
Apply gender and number agreement rules for color adjectives
Describe the color and shape of garments and classroom objects

topics.topic: Révision Générale de Grammaire, Vocabulaire et Dialogue Français
learningObjectives: Consolidate vocabulary on family, calendar, classroom, and numbers
Rehearse conversational dialogues covering introductions and descriptions
Review common pitfalls in article usage and auxiliary verb conjugations

topics.topic: Examen Terminal Écrit et Oral de Langue Française
learningObjectives: Administer standardized written French grammar and comprehension paper
Conduct one-on-one viva oral examinations assessing fluency and accent
Record cumulative continuous assessment and exam grades into broadsheets
